description: This Python source file implements a service class `GoogleLLMOpenAIBetaService` that interfaces with Google's Gemini API using an OpenAI-compatible format. It manages streaming chat completions, function call handling, and token usage metrics, specifically for integrating Google’s LLM models with an OpenAI-like API.
